title: WN Conference Cyprus ’26 is now accepting applications for participation in the game exhibition and indie pitch
summary: On September 17-18, WN Conference Cyprus’26 will be held in Limassol— a business conference for developers, publishers, and other representatives of the gaming industry. A key part of the conference will be the showcase of games by independent developers and the indie pitch.

title: Tariff compensation in the USA boosted PlayStation’s profits — and other insights from Sony’s report
summary: The Sony Corporation, following in Microsoft’s footsteps, has reported the results of the first quarter of the current fiscal year (April-June 2026). According to the document, its gaming division is more or less stable.

title: XBOX’s annual revenue has declined, but Satya Nadella remains optimistic
summary: Microsoft has concluded its financial results for 2026, which ended on June 30. It reported an overall increase in corporate revenue, though its gaming division did not perform as well.

title: Unity is no longer the leader — Godot has become the most popular engine at GMTK Game Jam 2026
summary: Last week, the popular annual GMTK Game Jam took place. Traditionally, the organizers asked the participants which engines they used for creating their projects. It turned out that, for the first time, the most frequently chosen was Godot.

title: Revenue Growth — and Other Successes in Capcom’s Quarterly Report
summary: The first quarter of the current fiscal year, lasting from April 1 to June 30, 2026, was highly successful for Capcom. In a recent report, the company announced growth in all key metrics.

title: Over seven years, the German government has allocated over a quarter of a billion euros for game development
summary: In 2019, Germany launched a support program for gaming companies, initially in a pilot phase. Since then, it has become officially established in the country, with developers and publishers receiving millions of euros in subsidies from the authorities.

title: The next WN Conference will take place on September 17-18 in Limassol. We are sharing the first details
summary: At the beginning of autumn, one of the largest cities in Cyprus will host a new session of the conference for developers and publishers organized by WN Media Group. Among its guests are expected representatives from Loot, Xsolla, Avow, OHM, ByteDance, GEM Capital, and many other companies.

title: All metrics have plummeted – key points from Ubisoft’s quarterly report
summary: The financial reporting period has arrived, and Ubisoft was quick to announce its results for April-June 2026. This marked the first quarter of the current fiscal year for the company, and it didn’t go very smoothly.

title: The European Commission has approved the sale of Electronic Arts for $55 billion
summary: The European antitrust regulator did not obstruct a consortium of investors led by the Saudi Public Investment Fund from purchasing Electronic Arts (EA). It granted permission for the deal to proceed.

title: In June, the US gaming market experienced a significant decline for the first time in a year
summary: The first month of summer has been revealed for the American gaming market. As usual, Circana analyst Mat Piscatella shared the statistics on social media.

title: Report: Playtika wants to sell SuperPlay — the studio turned out to be too successful
summary: The company Playtika is negotiating the sale of the studio behind Disney Solitaire, Dice Dreams, and Domino Dreams, claims Calcalist Tech. The potential buyer is Tencent.

title: Nearly a quarter of surveyed British developers have lost their jobs in the past three years
summary: The global gaming industry has been experiencing a significant crisis for several years. As the UK Interactive Entertainment Association (UKIE) revealed, a substantial portion of UK game development specialists have been affected by it.

title: EA believes that planning for in-game advertising placement should be done during the development stage
summary: Developing console and PC games with built-in advertising in mind from the start can significantly ease future efforts, claims Alexander Dao, Vice President of Advertising and Sponsorship at Electronic Arts (EA).

title: Pre-orders for GTA VI brought Take-Two a record $260 million in one week — Newzoo
summary: Analysts at Newzoo decided to examine how actively gamers are pre-ordering GTA VI. According to their estimates, the game has already achieved phenomenal box office success.

title: Third-party app stores will finally appear on Google Play, albeit only in the United States
summary: Google Corporation has agreed to allow third-party app stores on Google Play. Initially, a court attempted to force them to do this, but Google actively resisted. However, after negotiations with Epic Games, they decided to make concessions.

title: The creators of Splitgate and Empulse have laid off some employees
summary: The studio 1047 Games is once again hit by a wave of layoffs — just a few weeks after the team shooter Empulse launched in early access. The exact number of employees affected by the layoffs is still unclear.

title: It seems that Ubisoft no longer believes that “microtransactions make games more fun”
summary: Ubisoft published a report on the company’s performance for the past fiscal year, covering the period from April 1, 2025, to March 31, 2026. As noted by Game File journalist Stephen Totilo, a line about the “fun” side of microtransactions was removed from the document.

title: The number of gaming M&A has reached its highest point since 2022, according to analytics
summary: Analysts at Aream & Co. prepared a report on gaming deals in the second quarter of 2026. According to their observations, the investment market significantly revived during this period.

title: New details on layoffs at id Software — over 70% of the staff have been laid off, but the id Tech engine will not be abandoned
summary: Information continues to emerge about the situation at id Software in light of the XBOX restructuring. Among other things, it has become known that the layoffs at the studio were far more extensive than initially anticipated.

title: The source code of Unturned has been made available to the public
summary: In recent weeks, developers have actively shared the source codes of their projects. Now, Smartly Dressed Games has joined the list by publishing the code of the zombie sandbox game Unturned on GitHub.

title: Painful Restructuring at XBOX: 20% of Staff Laid Off and Plans to Reach 1 Billion Daily Players
summary: Yesterday, July 6, Microsoft officially confirmed rumors about restructuring its gaming division. Head of Xbox, Asha Sharma, published a letter to employees detailing what lies ahead for the team.

title: In 2025, mobile game advertising revenue exceeded $12 billion — analytics
summary: This conclusion was reached by the analytical company Sensor Tower.

title: miHoYo is the most valuable private gaming company in the world according to Hurun Research Institute, but there’s a catch
summary: The Hurun Research Institute published its annual ranking of the world’s most valuable private companies. The top of the list was dominated by AI firms, but there was also a spot for miHoYo — the studio behind Genshin Impact.

title: SuperCity’s revenue surpassed the $100 million mark
summary: SuperCity turned 15 years old — the city-building simulator from Playkot made its debut on June 1, 2011. In honor of the game’s anniversary, the developers shared its achievements.

title: Sony will stop producing PlayStation discs starting in 2028
summary: The end of the era of physical game editions is drawing closer. Sony announced that starting from January 2028, it will no longer release discs for new titles on PlayStation consoles.
